description: 夕食中の家庭で突然停電が起こり、部屋が暗くなって家族が驚いている。父親は懐中電灯を探し、母親は怖がっている小さな娘を抱きしめて安心させている。兄はスマートフォンのライトを使って周囲を照らしている。背景では、停電の瞬間に祖父が飲み物をこぼし、弟は暗闇でおもちゃにつまずいて転びそうになっている。冷蔵庫の前では祖母が中の食べ物を心配そうに確認し、窓の外では近所の家々も暗くなっており、懐中電灯を持って外の様子を確認している住民も見える。
imagePrompt: A high-quality, detailed illustration designed for an IELTS or Eiken English speaking picture-description test. Show a modern family dining room and living room in the evening during a sudden neighborhood power outage. The scene should be dark enough to clearly suggest that the electricity has gone out, but all people, objects, facial expressions, and actions must remain easy to see through smartphone lights, flashlights, candles, moonlight, and soft ambient lighting. The main event is in the foreground: a family was having dinner when the lights suddenly went out. A young girl looks frightened and surprised, and her mother is gently holding and comforting her. The father is searching inside a drawer or cabinet for a flashlight. An older teenage brother is using the flashlight on his smartphone to illuminate the room. Include several clear background sub-stories happening at the same time. An elderly grandfather has accidentally knocked over a glass of water or juice during the confusion and is trying to stop the liquid from spreading across the table. A younger boy has almost tripped over a toy on the floor because he cannot see clearly and is trying to regain his balance. Near the refrigerator, a grandmother is opening the refrigerator slightly and looking concerned about the food inside because the power is off. A family member is carefully lighting a candle on the table. Through a large window, show several neighboring houses with their lights also off, suggesting a wider blackout, and one or two neighbors outside holding flashlights and looking around. Include dinner plates, chairs, a sofa, toys, a refrigerator, curtains, a clock, smartphones, flashlights, candles, and spilled liquid. Make the main incident and every background action visually distinct and easy to describe. Clear foreground, middle ground, and background. Approximately 7 to 10 visible people. No speech bubbles, no captions, no brand logos, no copyrighted characters. Landscape 16:9 composition, clean colorful educational illustration style, detailed but uncluttered, with expressive body language and facial expressions.

sentences.text: The family is dealing with a sudden power outage during dinner.
sentences.ja: 家族は夕食中に起きた突然の停電に対応しています。

sentences.text: The young girl looks frightened because the room suddenly became dark.
sentences.ja: 部屋が突然暗くなったため、小さな女の子は怖がっています。

sentences.text: Her mother is trying to comfort her while her father searches for a flashlight.
sentences.ja: 父親が懐中電灯を探している間、母親は娘を安心させようとしています。

sentences.text: Her brother is using his smartphone to provide some light.
sentences.ja: 兄は周囲を照らすためにスマートフォンを使っています。

sentences.text: The grandfather is cleaning up a drink that he accidentally spilled.
sentences.ja: 祖父は誤ってこぼした飲み物を片づけています。

sentences.text: A younger boy almost fell after tripping over a toy in the dark.
sentences.ja: 小さな男の子は暗闇でおもちゃにつまずき、転びそうになりました。

sentences.text: The grandmother seems worried that the food in the refrigerator may go bad.
sentences.ja: 祖母は冷蔵庫の食べ物が傷むかもしれないと心配しているようです。

sentences.text: The dark houses outside suggest that the whole neighborhood has lost power.
sentences.ja: 外の家々も暗いため、近所全体が停電しているようです。

sentences.text: The household has been plunged into darkness by what appears to be a widespread power outage.
sentences.grammar: 現在完了受動態 / what節
sentences.ja: その家庭は、広範囲の停電と思われる事態によって突然暗闇に包まれています。

sentences.text: The young girl appears visibly alarmed by the abrupt loss of electricity, while her mother attempts to reassure her.
sentences.grammar: whileを用いた対比・同時進行
sentences.ja: 少女は突然電気が消えたことに明らかに怯えており、母親は彼女を安心させようとしています。

sentences.text: Her father is rummaging through a cabinet in search of an alternative source of illumination.
sentences.ja: 父親は代わりの明かりを探して戸棚の中を探っています。

sentences.text: The teenage son is using his smartphone to illuminate the surroundings so that the family can move around safely.
sentences.ja: 10代の息子は、家族が安全に移動できるようスマートフォンで周囲を照らしています。

sentences.text: Apparently startled by the blackout, the grandfather has knocked over his drink and is attempting to contain the spill.
sentences.grammar: 過去分詞を用いた分詞構文
sentences.ja: 停電に驚いたらしく、祖父は飲み物を倒してしまい、こぼれた液体が広がるのを食い止めようとしています。

sentences.text: A younger child is struggling to regain his balance after stumbling over a toy that he failed to notice in the darkness.
sentences.grammar: after＋動名詞 / 関係代名詞that
sentences.ja: 小さな子どもは暗闇で気づかなかったおもちゃにつまずき、バランスを取り戻そうとしています。

sentences.text: The grandmother appears apprehensive about whether the perishable food in the refrigerator can remain safely preserved.
sentences.ja: 祖母は、冷蔵庫の傷みやすい食品を安全に保存できるかどうか心配しているようです。

sentences.text: The fact that neighboring houses are also dark suggests that the disruption extends well beyond this single household.
sentences.ja: 近隣の家々も暗くなっていることから、停電はこの家庭だけでなく広い範囲に及んでいると考えられます。

sentences.text: Despite the initial confusion, the family members are cooperating to cope with the unexpected disruption safely.
sentences.ja: 最初は混乱していたものの、家族は予期せぬ停電に安全に対処するため協力しています。
